Name: domuti's Bachelors Portraits for Downtown Zuzu
Author: hozmacon
Description:
[size=4]This is a mod to replace the portraits of the[/size] [size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url] Bachelor NPCs with an edited version, using content patcher.

It includes vanilla-like personal style portraits of six marriage candidates.
Only portraits is switched by the config menu.[/size]

[size=3]I have greatly influenced by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12128?tab=description]PC's Alternative Portraits[/url], a super sexy reskin mod.






[u][size=5]To install[/size][/u]
[size=3]1. Install smapi, content patcher and Downtown Zuzu along with all condition mods
2. Download the mod and unzip it into the Mods folder[/size]





Downtown Zuzu Mod Originator: XxHarvzBackxX, Zuzu Development Team
[size=3]
[/size]
